# Code

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Rows made by JavaScript: `d` is the input's rows as objects (an empty array with nothing wired), or a JSON file parsed whole when a URL is set, and the body returns an array of rows or GeoJSON. d3, turf and utils are in scope. It runs when its input changes, in the engine, and its rows become a DuckDB table every later node plans over; for per-row values use a JS Function instead.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "code", "name": "code", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
